name: Eastmoreland Golf Course

dtm.source: DOGAMI lidar DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, box x 527771-529251 / y 5034421-5036669, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-19 (GitHub release data-eastmoreland, exportImage.4.tiff)

chm.source: DOGAMI lidar CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC (highest hit minus bare earth), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, same box, downloaded by the developer 2026-10-19 (GitHub release data-eastmoreland, exportImage.5.tiff)
chm.label: DOGAMI canopy height model

world.note: OSM course boundary (relation 11095178) bbox 920 x 1942 m in UTM 10N, centred in 1280 x 2048 m (whole 256 m chunks): 180 m of scenery east and west, 53 m north and south (the 2,048 m limit binds, as at East Potomac)

scorecard_source: Club scorecard PDF (Golf ScoreCards, Inc., 7/2007), from the developer (GitHub release data-eastmoreland); hole sums match the printed totals; the developer's card of record (2026-10-19). GolfPass lists a later card (other handicaps; hole 13 447/435; Yellow and Orange tees): open item. Red tees (women's par 74, own handicaps) in scorecard_full.csv, not built
attribution: Elevation and canopy height: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
notes: Developer, 2026-10-19: Blue is the default tee; every hazard is red (the lake, the pond by 16, the creek); the release scorecard (2007 card) is the card; pnw theme with the rhododendron garden painted as flower beds (garden key). Wind 1-7 mph as Oswego Lake (course chat)

garden.note: Crystal Springs Rhododendron Garden (OSM way 133795912), outside the golf boundary and out of bounds: flowering rhododendron and azalea bushes where the lidar canopy height model shows the shrub layer (0.6-7 m), and at half density under the taller canopy (pipeline/garden.py). Exported as trees.json c: 3 and drawn from sprites/shrubs.png (design chat, 2026-10-19); each bush's colour is drawn from `colours` (weights, from the developer's garden photos) and set by its place in trees.json (index % 8). Species and colours are flair, not surveyed. Developer 2026-10-19: 'pretty and have flowers'

join_boundary_parts.note: The OSM course boundary (relation 11095178) has two parts, the front nine south and the back nine north of SE Bybee Blvd (13.7 m apart). Both are in play: the game's single OB polygon joins them across the road (common.game_boundary); the road strip stays out of bounds on the surface map.
